reasons.plausibility: Zr segregation to grain boundaries enhancing cohesion is well-documented in refractory alloys, so the proposed mechanism is scientifically sound and fits established principles.
reasons.testability: The outlined comparative in-situ high-temperature mechanical tests with concurrent TEM/EDS mapping provide a clear and direct means to prove or disprove the role of Zr segregation.
reasons.usefulness: Pinpointing the impact of grain-boundary chemistry on high-temperature toughness directly informs the design of improved plasma-facing materials, making the hypothesis highly relevant.
